excerpts.content:
Quick implementation update: OpenEthereum can now sync to our 3074 testnet 🎉

You can get geth here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/tree/eip-3074
OpenEthereum here: https://github.com/quilt/openethereum/tree/eip-3074
Testnet Configs: https://github.com/quilt/baikal-testnet

We should have a fork of remix with AUTH/AUTHCALL support up relatively shortly to make playing around with it even easier.
